channel.title: zard/ui Changelog
channel.description: Latest updates and announcements from zard/ui: beautifully-designed, accessible Angular components inspired by shadcn/ui.

item.title: November 2026 - Create
item.description: Design how your app looks on the create page, then start it with one command. zard-cli create builds a new Angular, Nx or Analog app that already has your theme, fonts, icons and radius, so the first screen you open looks like yours and not like a template.

item.title: November 2026 - Data Table, Map and AI Elements
item.description: Our biggest month for new components yet. We added Data Table, Color Picker, Menubar, Native Select and Questionnaire, plus Code Block, Message Scroller and Trace for chat and agent interfaces, an interactive Map, and the AI Elements patterns built on top of them.

item.title: October 2026 - Right to Left
item.description: We made every component read right to left, so Arabic, Hebrew and Persian apps get the same library as everyone else. Turn it on when you run zard-cli init, or set dir="rtl" on your html tag, and see the RTL guide for fonts and migration.

item.title: September 2026 - Zard UI v1.0
item.description: The month v1.0.0 ships. The announcement below says what a stable 1.0 means.

item.title: August 2026 - Input OTP
item.description: One-time passwords land this month. We added the Input OTP component, with grouped slots, separators, pattern validation, and paste support out of the box.

item.title: July 2026 - Field, Item, Textarea and Sonner
item.description: Four new components this month — Field, Item, Textarea, and Sonner — and a reorganisation that moved every demo and API doc next to the component it documents.

item.title: May 2026 - Numeric Inputs and Alert Dialog
item.description: A quieter month focused on form correctness. We taught the input directive to speak numbers, and we changed one dialog default that had been surprising people.

item.title: April 2026 - Avatar Sizes and Dynamic Select
item.description: A thin month — two releases, no new components. One quietly narrows the Avatar zSize API to named sizes only; the other makes Select track option lists that keep changing after render.

item.title: March 2026 - Icons from ng-icons
item.description: Complete icon system migration! We replaced the custom ZardIconComponent with @ng-icons/lucide, bringing better tree-shaking, a wider icon selection, and a simpler API across all components.

item.title: February 2026 - zard-cli, Tree and SSR Dark Mode
item.description: The busiest month of the year outside August — 77 commits, most of them release automation. Underneath that: the CLI is renamed to zard-cli and hardened for monorepos, dark mode becomes safe under SSR, Button is restyled to match the latest shadcn/ui, Switch moves to a breaking model-input API, and Tree lands (it was removed again in August, see that entry).

item.title: January 2026 - Angular 21 and SSR-stable IDs
item.description: A quiet month by commit count but not by API surface: Angular 21 becomes the floor, every generated id moves to a new ZardIdDirective so server and client stop disagreeing, and both the input directive and Checkbox learn to honour the Reactive Forms disabled state.

item.title: December 2025 - provideZard() and a Private Registry
item.description: Major infrastructure improvements this month! We focused on developer experience with a new provider system, CLI enhancements with our own private registry, and streamlined dark-mode setup.

item.title: November 2025 - Carousel and Kbd
item.description: Major updates this month with new interactive components including Carousel, Button Group, Input Group, and Kbd components. Enhanced user experience with better form controls and keyboard navigation support.

item.title: October 2025 - Sheet and Empty
item.description: Breaking changes with icons migration from lucide-static to lucide-angular for better performance. New layout components including Sheet and Empty state component for better UX.

item.title: September 2025 - Progress, Skeleton and Spinner
item.description: Focus on loading and feedback components this month. New Progress, Skeleton, and Loader components for better perceived performance and user feedback during async operations.

item.title: August 2025 - Avatar, Divider and Breadcrumb
item.description: Enhanced navigation and display components. New Avatar component with fallback support, Divider for content separation, and Breadcrumb for hierarchical navigation.

item.title: July 2025 - Tabs, Accordion and Tooltip
item.description: Major release of navigation and content organization components. New Tabs for multi-view interfaces, Accordion for collapsible content, and Tooltip for contextual information. Theming system improvements with new color palettes.

item.title: June 2025 - Dialog, Popover and Dropdown Menu
item.description: Overlay components release! New Dialog, Popover, Alert Dialog, and Dropdown Menu components. CVA integration for type-safe styling variants across all components.

item.title: May 2025 - Form Controls
item.description: Comprehensive form controls release! New Select, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, and Slider components with full Angular Reactive Forms integration and ControlValueAccessor support.

item.title: April 2025 - Input and the CLI
item.description: Form foundations and CLI launch! New Input and Form components with validation support. Official CLI tool released for easy project initialization and component installation. The Form component has since been discontinued — use Field instead, which covers the same ground and is what the form guides are built on.

item.title: March 2025 - Initial Release
item.description: 🎉 Initial release of ZardUI! An Angular component library built with TailwindCSS v4, featuring standalone components, signal-based reactivity, and modern Angular architecture. Core components including Button, Card, Badge, Alert, and Table.
